zh: 修掉一个会让整个应用卡死的问题：轻提示（toast）那一层被放在了应用主题之外，导致第一帧就画不出来。表现是打开后停在首页、点任何东西都没有反应，也不报错。现在能正常打开、正常点击了。这个问题的根源从 0.2.2 就在，只是之前的版本里没有整屏去点过，所以一直没暴露。
en: Fixes a bug that froze the whole app: the toast layer was mounted outside the app's theme, so the very first frame could not be laid out. The app opened on the home screen and nothing responded to taps, without any error. It now opens and responds normally. The fault had been there since 0.2.2 — earlier builds simply never had every part of the screen tapped.
